title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: the promote doors ask ADR-0029 D9.9's question the save door asks (#23630)
body:
Fixes #23630
Clause-②: no

## What this does

The save door refuses an `object` row bound to a package that does not own the object (ADR-0029 D9.9, `overlayPackageMismatchError`, `OBJECT_OVERLAY_PACKAGE_MISMATCH` / `422`). A draft save is judged against the owner at the time of that save. So package Q's draft of an object that no row held yet was stored, correctly. Then package P saved a runtime-authored row of that object, and P owned it. Promoting Q's draft after that wrote Q's active row beside P's and answered success. The promotion never asked the save door's question. The registry write-through then refused the row into `applyObjectRegistryMutation`'s `console.warn` and kept serving P.

`promoteDraftForPublish` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`) is the one promotion step that both doors call: the per-item publish (`publishMetaItem`, `POST /api/v1/meta/:type/:name/publish`) and `publishPackageDrafts` (`POST /api/v1/packages/:id/publish-drafts`). It now asks `classifyObjectContribution(name, promoteInto)` after the gated draft read, and throws `overlayPackageMismatchError` on a `mismatch` verdict, before `repo.promoteDraft` writes. It is the save door's judge and envelope, unchanged: one refusal, no second dialect, no new code, no new message.

- **The package it judges** is `promoteInto`, the package the active row is written under. That is the stated binding, or, for a package-unbound draft adopted into the item's package (#23495), that package. The save door judges the address it resolved in the same way.
- **Not asked of sealed managed content.** The check is guarded by `!this.isSealedManagedItem(singularType, request.name)`. An object a code package ships is sealed (ADR-0131 D6). For that row the save door answers its package door first (`refusePackagedBaseOverride`, `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` / `403`, ahead of its D9.9 call). The promotion reaches the same refusal at the store (`repo.promoteDraft` → `assertAllowed`). Without the guard, `classifyObjectContribution`'s packaged `mismatch` arm answered `422` with a prescription ("bind to the owner") that the sealed rule refuses. This was contract-review finding ①4 (6195338637), and the seat ruled route (A) (6195354019).
- **Placement.** It sits with the other draft-body refusals the promotion already asks: the `name` refusal, the permission-set owner binding, the default record page and the elevated flow. So a batch publish aborts on it as on them (ADR-0067 D2), and a publish with no draft at the address still answers `404 NO_DRAFT`.
- **Member 2 of the card** is the package-less owner (the `sys_metadata` sentinel). It rides #23514 (its claim 6195283743 and dispatch 6195318252 pin `[P, Q, package-less]`), which will change `classifyObjectContribution`'s sentinel arm; this PR does not touch that arm. #23514 remains open; per 6187770366 the seat reopens this card if #23514's merged PR does not pin member 2.

## Measured before the fix (real composition, base `57994c311f`)

Real `ObjectQL` over a real `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3), the real `PackageServicePlugin`, `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` and `HttpDispatcher.handlePackages`. Packages `com.probe.p` and `com.probe.q` are installed. Q's draft of `probe_ticket` is saved (`saveMetaItem`, mode draft), then P's active row is saved:

| door | answer | stored rows | registry owner / served label |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `publishMetaItem({ type: 'object', name, packageId: Q })` | `success: true`, "Published draft — type=object, name=probe_ticket [seq=3]" | `active:com.probe.p`, `active:com.probe.q` | `com.probe.p` / P's |
| `POST /api/v1/packages/com.probe.q/publish-drafts` | `200`, `outcome: 'published'`, `failed: []` | `active:com.probe.p`, `active:com.probe.q` | `com.probe.p` / P's |

The batch door's answer to a refusal inside a promotion was read from the code at the base. Any throw from `promoteDraftForPublish` rolls the batch back and answers `200` with `success: false` and `outcome: 'refused'`. The causal draft is in `failed[]` with its own `code` (`clientFacingFailureCode`; `OBJECT_OVERLAY_PACKAGE_MISMATCH` is in the error-code ledger) and its message (a 4xx is quoted). Every other draft is listed `BATCH_ABORTED`. This PR keeps that declared shape (`PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema`) and adds nothing to it.


## Measured after the fix

New pin `packages/runtime/src/package-promote-runtime-owner-refusal.integration.test.ts`, 8 cases, on the same composition:

- **`publishMetaItem` naming Q:** throws `{ code: 'OBJECT_OVERLAY_PACKAGE_MISMATCH', status: 422 }`, with `packageId` Q and `ownerPackageId` P. Its message equals the save door's refusal of the same row; the test compares the two answers and pins no wording. Nothing is written: active rows `[P]`, Q's draft still stored, and the registry serves P.
- **`POST /packages/Q/publish-drafts`:** `200`, `success: false`, `outcome: 'refused'`, `publishedCount: 0`, `failedCount: 1`. `failed[0]` is the object with `code: 'OBJECT_OVERLAY_PACKAGE_MISMATCH'` and the save door's message. Nothing is written.
- **CONTROL, code-packaged owner, per door.** A code package O ships the object (registered as `registerApp` registers it: contributors only, `_packageId: O`, `_provenance: 'package'`), and Q's draft is a row stored before O shipped it, since the save door refuses that draft today. Nothing is written either way: no active row, Q's draft still stored, and the registry still serves O.
  - `publishMetaItem` naming Q answers `{ code: 'NOT_OVERRIDABLE', status: 403 }`. The save door answers the same for the same row.
  - `publish-drafts` answers `outcome: 'refused'` with `failed[0].code: 'NOT_OVERRIDABLE'`.
  - Neither answers `OBJECT_OVERLAY_PACKAGE_MISMATCH`.
- **CONTROL:** with no second-package owner, Q's draft is promoted by `publishMetaItem` and by `publish-drafts` (active `[Q]`, registry Q).
- **CONTROL:** the owner P's own draft is published by `publish-drafts` over P's row.
- **CONTROL:** `publishMetaItem` naming no package still promotes a package-unbound draft INTO P (#23495's adoption).

Red before:
- At the base `57994c311f`, the runtime-owner refusal cases read 2 failed and 4 passed.
- At `3f0acc173` (the first round's check, no guard), the two code-packaged CONTROLs failed and 6 passed. Each answered `OBJECT_OVERLAY_PACKAGE_MISMATCH` (per-item: `status: 422`) where `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` / `403` was pinned. Finding ①4 is reproduced.

Green after: 8 passed at `ea873b091`.

**Ablations**, both through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (WRAP mode, with a trap restore). Each rebuilt `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, and `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` proved the marker in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs`. Each restore proved the blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, the package rebuilt, `--absent` (marker in none of 24 built files) and the tree clean.

| ablation | mutated | predicted / observed | restored |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| the check itself, at `5c2385ebd`: `classifyObjectContribution(...)` replaced by a planted non-`mismatch` verdict | blob `fa49911fd8` → `034c466abb` | 2 red / 4 green; `Tests 2 failed \| 4 passed (6)`, the two refusal cases | 6 passed |
| the sealed-item guard, at `ea873b091`: `&& !this.isSealedManagedItem(singularType, request.name)` replaced by an always-true term | blob `700377269e` → `f2e19c39ab` | 2 red / 6 green; `Tests 2 failed \| 6 passed (8)`, the two code-packaged CONTROLs | 8 passed |

## Tests

**This round, at `ea873b091`.** That head merges `origin/main` at `cbe771270`, which includes #23646's `reassignOrphanedMetadata` change to `protocol.ts`. Every run was targeted, a declared narrowing; the whole-package farms are CI's this round.

| metadata-protocol, the 46 test files that name the promote doors or the D9.9 refusal (`publishMetaItem`, `publishPackageDrafts`, `promoteDraftForPublish`, `OBJECT_OVERLAY_PACKAGE_MISMATCH`, `classifyObjectContribution`, `overlayPackageMismatch`) | exit 0 · 46 files · 1039 passed |
| objectql, 14 save-door / promote-door / D9.9 files (`protocol-runtime-owner-overlay-refusal`, `protocol-object-overlay-layer`, `registry-object-overlay-layer`, `protocol-publish-package-drafts`, `publish-package-drafts-response-conformance`, `publish-meta-response-conformance`, `protocol-publish-canonical-fold`, `protocol-publish-rollback`, `protocol-lock-enforcement`, `protocol-delete-object-registry-heal`, `protocol-duplicate-package-unprefixed-object`, `default-record-page-save-door`, `protocol-commit-history`, `build-probes`) | exit 0 · 206 passed |

**First round, at `5298b986e`** (merging `origin/main` at `7e6e4e1da`):
- metadata-protocol whole suite, 3 shards: 236 files, 20563 tests passed, 19 skipped.
- Targeted objectql, runtime and rest files: green.
- Typecheck: exit 0.

## Gates

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `ea873b091`, the final head, against merge base `cbe771270`: 65 commands.
- **Prerequisite build.** A locked full `turbo run build` came first (75 tasks, exit 0).
- **The run.** All 65 then ran at that head, each with its exit code captured before any pipe, and every one exited 0. Among them:
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: "110 published require entry point(s) across 68 package(s) load".
  - `check:type-check-debt`: "1 ledger entr(ies) re-measured … none above its recorded number".
  - `check-adr-0087-registration`: `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.
- **`--ran`:** "65 derived, 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", a derived zero, since every entry recorded its exit code.
- **The working tree** was clean.

`origin/main` has since moved one commit, to `3bc407d30` (#23687, objectql's metadata-service copy). It touches none of this PR's three files and none of the derived inputs, so it was not merged.

CI owns everything the derivation does not place: the artifact-roster and wide-population families, the type-check lanes, Test Core, Build Core, dogfood and the whole-package suites.

## Acceptance notes

- **The batch door refuses inside its declared outcome, not with an HTTP 422.** `publish-drafts` answers `200` with `outcome: 'refused'` and the code and message in `failed[]`, the same shape as every other refusal inside a promotion (ADR-0067 D2, `PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema`). The card's "same code and prescription" holds in `failed[0].code` and `failed[0].error`.
- **The code-packaged owner keeps the sealed refusal.** Its promotion answers `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` / `403` from the store, as before this PR and as the save door answers. Both doors pin it. The changeset's "Unchanged" list names it.
- **`applyObjectRegistryMutation`'s note is now true of one more caller, and was left as is.** Its `mismatch` branch says it is unreachable from `saveMetaItem` and lists "rollback, publish promotion" as the other callers. Publish promotion now refuses at its producer too, and a sealed object's promotion never reaches the write-through. The note stays true and sits outside this card's surface. `rollbackMetaItem` restores an existing row under that row's own binding, so it mints no new binding.
- **Rows stored before D9.9 stay as they are.** This change rewrites and removes nothing. The uninstall pre-flight (#23473) already handles them.
